name: scrub-bar-seeks
description: Setting the scrub bar to the midpoint of the timeline moves mpv's time-pos to the midpoint of the duration.

steps.name: durationKnown
steps.note: The scrub fraction is multiplied by duration_ (PlayerShell.cpp:979-980), so seeking before the duration has arrived would land at 0.0 no matter how the manifest asked for it.
Paused first, so the seek target is held still and can be compared as a number. Left running, time-pos would race past the assertion and this scenario would measure the clock rather than the seek.

steps.name: value
steps.note: The declared Q_PROPERTY value (ShellSliders.hpp:27), written through the real setter so it emits valueChanged like a drag. The value is a 0..1 fraction of the timeline, not seconds - naming seconds here would be the classic misreading of this control.
Bounded settle for the seek to land in the core; the assertions below carry the scenario.

assertions.note: The fixture is exactly 12.000s, so half the timeline is 6.0s. This is the assertion that the seek reached the core: a build that updated the scrub bar's own picture without seeking would leave time-pos near 0 and fail here.
Pins the constant the previous assertion is computed from, so a fixture or load problem reports as its own failure instead of quietly invalidating the expected 6.0.
A seek is announced through the surface's position signal, which is how the dock's own labels follow it.
